note: The opencode free tier enforces an ACCOUNT-WIDE daily request cap, which is exhausted for every model on this account, not just this one. The block is terminal until the reset: `opencode run -m opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free` exits 1 with 'Free usage limit reached' before any model call is made. The batch was stopped at the first such error rather than spending one doomed call per remaining finding, which is what turned a credential failure into a fake per-finding measurement in the S5 rerun (see docs/evidence/S5_docgen_blocked.json). This file records the block ONLY; no S7_llm_review.json and no S7_sample.json were written, deliberately, because the LLM precision / threshold / cost tables they hold were not measurable in this run.
why_not_retried_within_this_run: The cap is account-wide and terminal until the quota reset. A retry sooner returns the same exit-1 for every finding.
